'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] lists preconditions for [[ceasefire|ending]] the war between [[Iran]], [[Israel]], and the [[United States]]. The conditions include recognizing Iran's [[sovereignty|legitimate rights]], payment of reparations, and firm international guarantees against future aggression. [https://english.news.cn/20260312/3b85b3af3ac5430b9b788e6108a1e1d6/c.html (Xinhua)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****The [[Thailand]]-[[flag state|flagged]] [[bulk carrier]] {{ship|MV|Mayuree Naree|2007|6}} is hit by two Iranian missiles shortly after passing the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. Twenty people are rescued and three are reported missing after the vessel catches on fire. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/thailand-says-3-crew-missing-after-ship-hit-by-projectiles-strait-hormuz-2026-03-11/ (Reuters)]
****Two [[Cargo ship|cargo vessels]], the [[Marshall Islands]]-flagged ''Star Gwyneth'', operated by [[Star Bulk Carriers]], and the [[Japan]]-flagged ''ONE Majesty'', operated by [[Mitsui OSK Lines]], are struck by unknown projectiles, with no casualties reported. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/economy/1297708/greek-owned-vessel-among-three-hit-near-strait-of-hormuz/ (''Kathimerini'')] 
****A bulk carrier is hit by an unknown projectile 50[[Nautical mile|NM]] northwest of [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.ukmto.org/-/media/ukmto/products/20260311-ukmto_warning_020-26.pdf?rev=4855fffc68324923a752024b4b6b574f (UKMTO)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Oman]]
****Iran drones [[drone warfare|strike]] oil storage facilities at the port of [[Salalah]], causing several fuel tanks to burst into flames. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/oil-storage-facilities-hit-omans-salalah-port-ambrey-state-tv-say-2026-03-11/ (Reuters)] [https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oman-Evacuates-Key-Oil-Port-as-Iran-War-Intensifies.html (Oil Price)]
***[[Iraq in the 2026 Iran war]]
****Two [[Tanker (ship)|tankers]] carrying [[Petroleum industry in Iraq|Iraqi oil and gas]], [[Marshall Islands]]-flagged ''Safesea Vishnu'' and [[Malta]]-flagged ''Zefyros'', catch fire after being struck in [[Iraq|Iraqi]] territorial waters off [[Khor Al Zubair]] [[List of ports in Iraq|Port]] and near the [[Al-Faw]] port area. An Indian member of the first crew is killed in the attack. [https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Two-Oil-Tankers-Set-Ablaze-Near-Iraqs-Key-Export-Terminals.html (Oil Price)] [https://www.deccanherald.com/india/indian-crew-member-dies-in-attack-by-iran-against-us-owned-oil-tanker-safesea-vishnu-3929335 (''Deccan Herald'')]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****Seven people are killed and 23 others are injured after an [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] strike on [[Temnine Et Tahta]], [[Baalbek-Hermel Governorate]], [[Lebanon]]. Five people are also injured after a strike on the nearby village of [[Aali en Nahri]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cd70wzw9vqlt?post=asset%3A9f40e711-67e7-4f96-ba6a-48cfdf365c6b#post (BBC News)]
****[[Hezbollah]] launches over 100 rockets at Israel, injuring five civilians in [[Upper Galilee]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-889639 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**<!-- Do NOT place under the "Iran war" subheader unless a reliable source explicitly mentions that the drones came from Iran. --> Four people are injured in the [[United Arab Emirates]] after two drones fall near [[Dubai International Airport]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260311/d32a9c1a9907498085b96c176b557752/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**A [[United Nations]] aid worker from [[France]] is killed in a series of explosions caused by drone strikes in [[Goma]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], with the occupying [[March 23 movement|M23 rebels]] blaming the [[Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-goma-drone-attack-606b7feba8685436d1f757de65d4efce (AP)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**At least 17 people are killed in a [[drone warfare|drone strike]] on a secondary school and a health center in Shukeiri, [[White Nile State]], [[Sudan]]. Local authorities and the [[Sudan Doctors Union]] blame the [[Rapid Support Forces]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-war-rsf-military-drone-schoolgirls-e1e102861f0d4cc193a51669f297c670 (AP)]
**Over 20 people are killed and 23 others injured in a [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] drone strike in [[Abu Zabad]], [[West Kordofan]], Sudan. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/drone-strikes-hit-west-darfur-market-bombing-resumes-in-south-kordofan-as-sudan-fighting-intensifies (Dabanga Sudan)]
*[[Terrorism in Norway]]
**[[Norway|Norwegian]] [[Norwegian Police Service|police]] arrest three brothers on suspicion of involvement in a bombing outside the [[Embassy of the United States, Oslo|U.S. embassy]] in [[Oslo]] on 8 March that caused minor damage but no injuries. A terrorist motive is suspected. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/three-brothers-arrested-over-us-embassy-blast-in-oslo-police/ (AFP via CTV News)]

'''Business and econony'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***The [[International Energy Agency]] agrees to discharge 400 million barrels of oil from its members’ strategic reserves, its largest-ever release, to counter soaring global energy prices due to the war. Despite the measure, the price of the crude barrel rises above [[United States dollar|US$]]100 again in international markets. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/11/iea-proposes-release-of-400m-barrels-of-oil-from-strategic-reserves (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.forbes.com/sites/siladityaray/2026/03/11/crude-hits-100-per-barrel-as-strategic-oil-reserve-release-fails-to-calm-iran-war-fears/ (''Forbes'')]
**[[Wynn Resorts]] says it plans to resume construction on the upcoming [[Wynn Al Marjan Island|Al Marjan Island]] resort in [[Ras Al Khaimah]] following a short pause amidst the war. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/wynn-resorts-resumes-construction-uae-luxury-project-after-brief-pause-2026-03-11/ (Reuters)] [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/property/work-on-wynn-al-marjan-resumes-after-a-short-pause-due-to-israel-iran-war?_refresh=true (''Khaleej Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Spain relations]]
**[[Spain]] permanently withdraws [[List of ambassadors of Spain to Israel|its ambassador]] to [[Israel]] and terminates the position after bilateral [[diplomatic relations]] worsened this week. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/spain-removes-ambassador-israel-2026-03-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
**The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations Security Council|Security Council]] approves a [[United Nations resolution|resolution]] condemning Iran's attacks on the [[Gulf Cooperation Council]] states and [[Jordan]]. The text, presented by [[Bahrain]] and co-sponsored by 135 countries, is passed with 13 votes in favor and the abstentions of [[Russia]] and [[People's Republic of China|China]]. [https://press.un.org/en/2026/sc16315.doc.htm (United Nations Press)]
*[[Romania–United States relations]], [[2026 Iran war]]
**[[Romania]] authorizes the [[United States]] to use [[List of Romanian Air Force bases|its air bases]] to refuel [[List of active United States military aircraft|aircraft]] and deploy monitoring and [[Communications satellite|satellite communications]] equipment in support of [[United States Armed Forces|military]] operations related to the Iran war, following approval by the [[Parliament of Romania|Romanian parliament]] and the [[Supreme Council of National Defence (Romania)|Supreme Council of National Defence]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2026/03/11/three-brothers-arrested-over-us-embassy-blast-in-oslo-police (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship of TikTok]], [[Mass media in Albania]]
**The [[Albania]]n [[Constitutional Court of Albania|constitutional court]] rules that [[Rama IV Government|the government]]'s ban on the [[social media]] platform [[TikTok]] violated [[Constitution of Albania|constitutional]] protections for [[freedom of expression]] and [[press freedom]], after authorities blocked the service in 2025 following a fatal stabbing linked to a dispute on the platform. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260311-albania-tiktok-ban-violated-free-speech-court-rules (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Europol]] reports that more than 330 people in 70 countries have been arrested during an international operation against [[Transnational organized crime|organized networks]] suspected of [[Global waste trade|trafficking illegal waste]] within Europe and exporting it to Africa, Asia, and Latin America, with large quantities of [[dangerous goods]] and nearly [[Euro|€]]10 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]11.6 million) in assets seized. [https://www.reuters.com/world/more-than-330-arrested-europol-led-operation-against-illicit-waste-trade-2026-03-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Chilean general election]]
**[[José Antonio Kast]] is sworn in as [[President of Chile]], succeeding [[Gabriel Boric]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2026/03/11/chile-kast-inauguration-new-administration/f90f47d0-1d06-11f1-a29c-fd43da9a479a_story.html (''Washington Post'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]], [[Iran at the FIFA World Cup]]
**[[Ministry of Sport and Youth (Iran)|Iranian sports minister]] [[Ahmad Donyamali]] states that [[Iran national football team|Iran]] will not participate in the 2026 [[FIFA World Cup]] to be hosted by [[Canada]], [[Mexico]], and the [[United States]], citing security concerns amid the Iran war. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/iran-cannot-participate-world-cup-sports-minister-says-2026-03-11/ (Reuters)]
